name: Serperior, The Snake Eye Emperor
desc:
2 Plant monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned by "Contrary Fusion".
While this Fusion Summoned card is on the field: All monsters you control become Plant-Type, also neither player can Special Summon more than once per turn.
While you control another Plant monster: Negate all your opponent's effects that include an effect that would negate the activation or effect of a card.
While you control another Plant monster (Quick Effect): When your opponent activates a card effect, you can send 1 face-up Plant monster on the field to the GY, or banish 1 Plant monster in your GY face-down; destroy 1 face-up card on the field. You can only use this effect of "Serperior, The Snake Eye Emperor" twice per turn.
strings: Send 1 Plant or banish 1 Plant from GY: destroy 1 card
